Get ready to witness one of India's most breathtaking railway journeys!
Welcome to the beautiful Araku Valley in Andhra Pradesh, where spectacular mountains, dense forests, mysterious tunnels and breathtaking landscapes make the KK Line one of the most scenic railway routes in India.
In this video, I take you on a stunning aerial journey through the picturesque railway section near Tyada in Alluri Sitharama Raju District, Andhra Pradesh.
